question: Is the Universe infinite?
short_answer: Observational evidence shows the observable universe is finite (93 billion light-years across), but the entire unobservable Universe may be infinite in extent.
full_explanation: Measurements of CMB geometry indicate the Universe is flat to within 0.4% margin of error, which mathematically supports an infinite spatial extent.

acceptedAnswer.text: Observational evidence shows the observable universe is finite (93 billion light-years across), but the entire unobservable Universe may be infinite in extent.
